result.brief: 提出 NAPE，用因果 Transformer 预测下一音频 patch 嵌入的自监督框架，无需解码器或 tokenizer，在音频语音任务上取得强表现。
result.reason: Audio-only SSL via next-patch-embedding prediction; no video, visual, or multimodal representation contribution, though the causal next-embedding paradigm parallels JEPA-style visual learning.
